reverie.title: REVERIE — the darkness where katita followed sound
narr: Your hand finds the wall. Katita is ahead, her footsteps
the only light you have. The darkness is not empty — it is
humming. She stops, places her palm flat against the stone,
and you feel it: a frequency so low it lives in your chest.
"Listen," she says. "The archive is teaching itself to hear."
In the dark, you both understand.
